items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: my mother's maiden name was Ratliff, R-A-T-L-E-F-F.

ctx.x: Naval. Naval. Well, now, what was your mother's maiden name? Did you
tell her? My mother's maiden name was, my mother's maiden name was Ratliff, R-A-T-L-E-F-F.
And her first name? George Henry. George Anna Wright, I thought, see. And then the Begards and the Pirones are on, and I can't keep it all straight. Well, no,
